claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says a ship’s holographic computer reads its owner’s thoughts and executes commands; crew disagreement can halt it.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: Household devices access it through the ship computer.

claims.assertion: She describes some ships as genetically engineered, sentient beings that adapt to crew and can partly self-repair.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says temporal travel is widely available, but misuse can be serious; suitability depends on ethics, training, and experience.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: Technology itself is not the distinction.

review_flags: The source makes extraordinary claims about sentient spacecraft and temporal travel; all are recorded as attributed lore.
coverage_gaps: the ship’s ability to insert inanimate objects and its limits regarding living beings
Swaruu’s account of a temporal mission and her reported death in an engine explosion
